title: api: standardize rate-limit semantics and idempotency for streaming + OpenAI compat
author: Sana Gupta
description: Motivation: customer-facing instability during streaming retries and inconsistent rate-limit behavior from the OpenAI compatibility layer led to developer confusion and incorrect client retry loops. This PR unifies Retry-After semantics across the API (supporting both delta-seconds and HTTP-Date formats), standardizes error payloads and status codes, and extends idempotency handling to streaming endpoints and the OpenAI compatibility shim. High level changes: 1) Server: parse and honor Retry-After header variants and expose a normalized X-Redwood-Retry-After (seconds) for internal routing and client SDKs; 2) Idempotency: accept Idempotency-Key on streaming endpoints, persist partially-committed streamed responses (prefix checkpoint) and allow safe client retries that resume or return the original response where applicable; 3) Error model: unify structured error JSON {"type","code","message","retry_after_seconds"} and map OpenAI-style errors to Redwood codes to provide stable semantics for SDKs; 4) OpenAI compat: update the compat layer mapping so openai_error.type -> redwood_error.code and include Retry-After propagation; 5) Tests & docs: add unit/integration coverage for retry-after parsing, idempotent streaming flows, and update OpenAI compatibility docs and SDK changelogs. Migration notes: clients should prefer Idempotency-Key on long-running streams and rely on the numeric X-Redwood-Retry-After header introduced here when present. Rollout: staged on dedicated and hosted; private installer contains opt-in flag until customers validate KV persistence behavior.
commits: normalize: parse Retry-After HTTP-date and delta-seconds (server)
feat(api): accept Idempotency-Key on streaming endpoints and checkpoint stream state
chore(compat): map openai error types to redwood codes and propagate retry-after
test: add integration tests for idempotent stream retries and retry-after handling
docs: update openai_compat.md and sdk changelogs

Riley Martinez: Integration tests flaky on initial run, looks like a race in stream checkpoint flush; can you add a short backoff?
Sana Gupta: Added small jittered backoff and increased test timeouts; re-ran CI and confirmed stability.
Morgan Lee: Approving after tests green and docs updated. /approve
release_notes: - Standardize Retry-After parsing (delta-seconds and HTTP-date) and expose X-Redwood-Retry-After (seconds) for clients; - Add idempotency support for streaming endpoints (Idempotency-Key) with checkpointing and safe retry semantics; - Unified structured error payloads and OpenAI compatibility mapping for consistent error codes; - SDK changelogs updated to use numeric retry header;
